name: PASSENGER x PRINCESS: NO HOPE // MUST DIE
source:
A self abating husk is forcefully coerced into a suicide pact by a "perfect" girl drowning in ennui and despair. 

The result is unfathomable heart rending terror and confusion.

What freedom and joy can they claw back in the time they have left? How much pain will come with it?

[From [url=https://lunaticker.itch.io/passenger-x-princess]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个自我毁灭的躯壳被一个淹没在倦怠和绝望中的“完美”女孩强行强迫签订了自杀协议。

结果是深不可测的令人心碎的恐惧和混乱。

在剩下的时间里，他们还能找回什么自由和快乐呢？随之而来的会有多少痛苦？

[来自[url=https://lunaticker.itch.io/passenger-x-princess]itch.io[/url]]
